authorization: Publisher authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Ralph Lauren's reported margin included a tariff refund, but adjusted margin, AUR and Asia growth indicate broader full-price strength that now faces a slower holiday test.

identity.units: USD millions except per-share data and basis points

duplicate_checks: Checked both editorial inventories, the JSON inventory and actual wealth content; Ralph Lauren has a maintained profile but no full-price-demand-versus-refund margin analysis.
Checked recent publication records, live content and open and merged PRs; no matching Ralph Lauren story, fingerprint or active attempt was found.
Checked the 9 November Europe/Dublin scheduled ledger before drafting; all three slots were open.
Routine quarterly results remain on /stocks/rl/; this article addresses pricing, regional mix and margin quality.
candidate_review_reference: See 3ee0584d66321731ed50b722.json for the ten-company screen; Ralph Lauren was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Fiscal Q2 revenue was USD2.1933bn, up 9%; reported gross margin was 74.2%, up 620 basis points; adjusted gross margin was 70.5%, up 250 basis points.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release income-statement review and Form 10-Q statements/reconciliation.
evidence_table.result: verified; reported and adjusted measures separated

evidence_table.claim: DTC comparable sales rose 10% and AUR rose 9%; adjusted operating margin was 15.7%, up 160 basis points.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release strategic highlights and income-statement review.
evidence_table.result: verified; AUR described as mix-sensitive operating metric

evidence_table.claim: Asia revenue was USD571m, up 28%, and Asia operating margin was 27.4%, up 240 basis points; North America and Europe figures were kept separate.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release regional review and Form 10-Q segment disclosures.

evidence_table.claim: The filing recorded an USD82.3m tariff-refund benefit in cost of goods sold and USD33.2m of related charitable donations in restructuring and other charges.
Cash and short-term investments were USD1.822bn, debt about USD1.2bn, inventory USD1.151bn, and first-half buybacks USD500m; operating cash was USD172.3m and capex USD114.2m.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release balance-sheet review and filing balance sheet/cash-flow/equity notes.

evidence_table.claim: Management guides to 6%-7% comparable constant-currency annual growth and 80-100 basis points of operating-margin expansion; Q3 guidance is 3%-4% and 50-70 basis points.

fact_check_pass.method: Every material number, fiscal period, region, accounting measure, management explanation and guidance item was reread against the release and Form 10-Q; reported, adjusted and constant-currency measures were kept distinct.
